testcase.name: Scenario: Open a saved drawing alongside an existing part: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-opening-source/features/application/document-opening/document-opening.feature:59:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open a saved drawing alongside an existing part ✔ Given writable copies of `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenDrawingA.odd`, `OpenDrawingB.odd` and `OpenPart.opd` are staged in the same working folder ✔ And the user opens each drawing, inserts a base view referencing the staged OpenPart.opd, saves it and closes it ✔ Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a saved drawing with a sheet, border and view is available and not already open ✔ And `OpenPart.opd` is the active part and `OpenDrawingA.odd` is closed ✔ When the user presses Control+O and selects the drawing ✔ And the user chooses Open ✔ Then the Open dialog closes ✔ And the drawing becomes active in a new document tab ✔ And the drawing sheet and border are displayed ✔ And the drawing browser lists the sheet and a view ✔ And the part document tab remains available
